name: Ca tram song Son
summary: Son River grass carp is the fish the Quang Binh visitor portal’s 20 May 2025 article calls the emblem of eating at Phong Nha-Ke Bang. The same article says the flesh is firm and not fishy, and it singles out pepper kho with pickled vegetables.
origin: Sơn Trạch, Bố Trạch, on the Quang Binh visitor portal’s 20 May 2025 article. Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park also names a Son River grass-carp contest and does not give the date.
culture: Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park says a Son River grass-carp contest is still held with the boat-racing festival on the Son. It does not print the 2026 date. The date is Check on arrival.
texture: The 20 May 2025 article says the flesh is firm and not fishy, because the fish feeds in the Son.
taste: That article calls cá trắm kho tiêu savory and serves it with pickled vegetables.
howToEat: The 20 May 2025 article lists steamed, kho, and grilled, and singles out pepper kho with pickled vegetables.
The same article says cá chép and lươn are raised in the cages at Sơn Trạch and does not describe a plate for either.
A door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The Son at Sơn Trạch, Bố Trạch, as the 20 May 2025 article prints it. A shop address is Check on arrival.
